entry_activation_level.label: 15m upper-value reclaim
entry_activation_level.reason: Require price to retake the local 15m upper-value / sell-imbalance band after the pullback, confirming the dip is being absorbed and reducing the risk of buying directly into a failed bounce.

entry_zone.label: Upper shelf retest zone
entry_zone.reason: Preferred long fill on a retest of the 15m VAL/POC cluster and reclaimed 1D VAH shelf once reclaim is confirmed; this avoids chasing with 2149.37-2157.99 nearby overhead.

entry_invalidation_level.label: Shelf failure band
entry_invalidation_level.reason: If price accepts back below the 2141.19 shelf and starts trading through the 4H single-print floor near 2139.24, the chosen retest setup has structurally failed and rotation back into lower 4H value is more likely.
